newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela privatization law reform seen for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela privatization law reform seen for Tuesday.

text.p: A reform to Venezuela's privatization law allowing local investors to buy shares in state assets via the local stock market should be passed by Nov 29, lawmakers said Thursday.
Legislators are discussing six versions of the reform but insisted that one of them would be approved by Tuesday.
The government wants the reform ahead of major privatizations in telecommunications and metals companies.

"With the reforms small investors will have the chance to become shareholders in state companies," the Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) -- the state body in charge of privatizations -- said in a a release.
The FIV added that incentives would be included in the reform, to encourage small investors to buying between 100,000 bolivars ($210) and five million bolivars ($10,640) worth of shares.
